results.correct_value: Seasonal: reachable only while SR-20 over Washington Pass is open (it is gated from roughly Nov/Dec to Apr/May).
results.evidence: WSDOT closes SR-20 for the winter between the Ross Dam trailhead and the Silver Star gate, taking in Washington Pass (5,475 ft); the 2025 closure was Dec 4. It typically reopens in April or early May depending on snowpack. The crag cannot be reached by car in winter, so 'year-round' is wrong; access, road, climate and season already agree.

patches.find: accessible year-round on good weather days
patches.replace: for good-weather days whenever SR-20 is open, roughly late spring to early winter

results.correct_value: Lower off the bolted anchor at the top; single pitch, no walk-off or rappel needed.
results.evidence: These are single-pitch (15-21 m) bolted routes ending at fixed anchors (Unnamed 6: bolted anchor on a small ledge, lowered from the top; Honeymoon Sweet: chain anchor at top of cliff); a 60 m rope lowers them. The row's descent_text, rappels/bail and rope fields all describe lowering; the short descent field (hidden on screen as the shorter) is the lone outlier.

patches.expect: Walk off or rappel from bolted anchors at route top
patches.value: Lower off the bolted anchor at the top; single pitch, no walk-off or rappel needed.

results.correct_value: gain_ft 300 is right; the hairpin trailhead is ~5,150 ft, not 5,400/5,477
results.evidence: The SR-20 hairpin pullout (Kangaroo Pass trailhead) is given as 5,150 ft in one trip report and 5,160 ft on the Mountaineers route page; the USGS 1 m DEM at the pullout coordinate reads 5,151 ft, while the crag is listed at 5,500 ft (DEM at the crag pin: 5,454 ft). So ~300 ft of gain is right and the trailhead pin elevation (5,400/5,477 — 5,475 ft is Washington Pass itself, not the hairpin below it) is the wrong field.

results.fact: Trailhead pin location vs stated distance
results.evidence: The pin at 48.5269,-120.6506 sits near Washington Pass itself (USGS DEM 5,567 ft there), roughly 0.9 mi from the crag, whereas the hairpin pullout used by the sibling Unnamed 5 row (48.51454,-120.64332) is ~0.15 mi from the crag, matching distMi 0.2. The wrong value is the pin's coordinate, which is out of scope for this pass; distMi is correct as a walking distance.

results.fact: Approach time (approach prose 10-15 min vs timing.approachTimeHrs 0.12)
results.evidence: Only one external source found: the Spire Gully area page gives a seven-minute approach from the hairpin. In the row, timing.approachTimeHrs 0.12 (~7 min) and the waypoint note agree with it against the approach prose's 10-15 minutes, but that is short of the 4-field internal bar and no second independent source was found (the DEM gives ~300 ft over ~0.2 mi, consistent with either).

results.correct_value: Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest (Methow Valley Ranger District)
results.evidence: Washington Pass and the SR-20 corridor below it lie in the Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest, Methow Valley Ranger District (Forest Service district page; WTA Washington Pass Overlook listing). The row's own land_manager, notes and emergency.rangerStation already say so; landManager 'N/A' is the outlier.
